data_contract.evaluation: Per option type and horizon: reliability bins, expected calibration error, Brier score and a bootstrap interval, over at least PROBABILITY_GATE['min_evaluation_days'] days and PROBABILITY_GATE['min_sample_size'] resolved contracts, on forecasts recorded out of sample.
data_contract.purpose: What must be stored, per listed contract, before any probability of profit can be calibrated.
data_contract.resolution: A contract resolves only at its expiration with a verified closing price from the same price source used for the listing; early exits are not modelled.
data_contract.storage: Append-only, one line per listed contract, written at listing time and completed at expiration; never rewritten, never back-filled from later knowledge.

missing_data: Historical option chains with bid and ask at each weekly as-of date: none are stored (Cboe provides current chains only, and option collection was off for every published snapshot).
Realized underlying prices at each contract's expiration, matched to the contracts that were listed: none, because no contracts have been listed and expired yet.
A model that records a probability for each listed contract BEFORE its expiration, so the forecast can be scored against the outcome.
An out-of-sample evaluation period of at least a year per option type and horizon with at least 200 resolved contracts, which cannot exist before the lists have run for that long.
Transaction-cost assumptions that match the broker actually used (fees are currently not deducted).
probability.statement: Probability not established — insufficient validated evidence.
